title: Math Tooling Notebook
user: An adult returning to mathematics who needs hands-on fluency with graphs, symbolic notation, estimates, and checks before tackling a formal course.
smallest_useful_product: Static web notebook with 20 tool-literacy drills, an embedded function plotter, scratchpad, estimation reveal, and local progress.
success_measure: At least 50% of new users complete five drills and correctly choose graph, table, estimate, or algebraic check on a six-question transfer quiz.
constraints: Permissively licensed math rendering/plotting only; WCAG-friendly graph alternatives; no exam-prep claims.
